sentences.en: A bat flying in the sky looks like a butterfly.
sentences.zh: 一只蝙蝠在天空中飞翔看起来像是一只蝴蝶。

sentences.en: He picked up a butterfly between his thumb and forefinger.
sentences.zh: 他用拇指和食指夹起了一只蝴蝶。

sentences.en: One day this caterpillar will turn into a beautiful butterfly.
sentences.zh: 总有一天这只毛虫会变成一只美丽的蝴蝶。
